Welcome to the Colorado Institute of Massage Therapy!
This is not just a channel to help you discover if massage is the right career for you....it's also about self-care tools, massage tips, medical massage and tricks of the trade to help bring success to your massage practice!

We all could use more information on helping ourselves and others, right!
